info.title: Skotos Control Plane API
info.description: Control Plane REST API for managing Skotos organizations, projects, environments, feature flags, targeting rules, simulations, revisions, audit logs, API tokens, and members.

200.description: Login succeeded; sets HttpOnly skotos_session cookie

ClauseOp.description: Exact 15 canonical clause operators locked in PROJECT.md.

Context.description: Evaluation context: either a single context ({"kind":"user","key":"...",...}) or a multi-context ({"kind":"multi","user":{...},"organization":{...}})

ContextMeta.description: Metadata attached to a single evaluation context (`_meta`).

EvaluationDetail.description: Detailed result returned by the evaluation engine.

EvaluationReason.description: Structured explanation of why a variation was served.

FlagPatchInstruction.description: Canonical 23-variant semantic instruction patch enum for feature flag mutations.

PatchSummaryItem.description: Human-readable description of a single semantic patch instruction for UI diffs and audit logs.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` error payload returned by all `control-api` 4xx/5xx responses.
